title: Core -00 non-normative semantic test harness
description: Validates the abstract input facts and expected observations used by the first Core -00 vector slice. This is not a WEXP record, protocol wire format, carrier, or source of WEXP semantics.

structure.description: Core record structure has already passed the schema check.

canonicalization.description: The serialization's canonical signing input has already been produced successfully.

timestamps.description: All applicable Core timestamp checks have already succeeded.

signature.description: A present signature has already been verified successfully.

key_binding.description: The signing key has already been resolved and bound successfully.

capabilities_resolution.description: capabilities_ref has already resolved to the accepted effective Conformance Class supplied by the harness.

hash_algorithms.description: Every field or evidence reference represented as present uses a supported hash algorithm and is honored.

recorder_qualification.description: No profile-defined recorder qualification or recorder ceiling applies.

chain.description: No chain or composition minimum applies.

boundary_type.description: The registered model.boundary_type value declared in the record after structure validation. Core evaluates and bounds the declared value under its signature, Conformance Class, and evidence rules; this harness fact does not independently prove that the real environment matched the declaration.

arguments_hash.description: True means input.arguments_hash is present, syntactically valid, uses a supported algorithm, and is honored; false means the WL1/WL2 conditional field is not available.

execution_fields.description: True means all four Section 6.1 WL3 fields execution.started_at, execution.ended_at, execution.outcome, and execution.result_hash are present, syntactically valid, use supported algorithms where applicable, and are honored; false means the complete WL3 condition is not met.

bound_provenance.description: True means a top-level provenance evidence-ref is present, syntactically bound to the record under Core, uses a supported digest algorithm, and is honored; false means the WL4 artifact condition is not met. The harness does not appraise artifact internals.

bound_independent_verification.description: True means a top-level independent-verification evidence-ref is present, syntactically bound to the record under Core, uses a supported digest algorithm, and is honored; false means the WL5 artifact condition is not met. The harness does not appraise artifact internals.
